definition.title: Canonical examples
definition.description: Reference problems for understanding and testing reusable evidence patterns.

useCases.label: Locate a heavy marble
useCases.description: Determine whether a weighing record identifies the containing bag or the exact heavy marble.

useCases.label: Choose a marble investigation
useCases.description: Compare the modeled value of another comparison with choosing now under exact-identity or containing-bag consequences.

useCases.label: Deliver the heavy-marble bag
useCases.description: Find a complete plan to deliver the identified bag with its seal and identifying record within the accepted time and expense limits.

definition.title: Food supply chains
definition.description: Food production and distribution networks and their tracing relationships.

useCases.label: Identify firms for a tracing inquiry
useCases.description: Determine which firms belong on an inquiry list across permitted product and business-role explanations.

definition.title: Network operations
definition.description: Network monitoring and diagnosis from declared topology and test records.

useCases.label: Locate network faults
useCases.description: Determine which fault zones and individual node failures are established by path-test results.

definition.title: Order fulfillment
definition.description: Plan complete deliveries against accepted readiness, resource, permission, timing and financial constraints.

useCases.label: Complete the first shipment
useCases.description: Compare complete shipment plans that must meet every mandatory obligation across the declared readiness and travel scenarios.

useCases.label: Review a first shipment
useCases.description: Can we meet this delivery commitment, and what should we verify before committing money?

definition.title: Product launches
definition.description: Decisions about preparing, reviewing and committing a scoped product launch.

useCases.label: Choose a launch-readiness review
useCases.description: Compare early review and response policies before a launch reservation deadline.

definition.title: Walmart Supplier Operations
definition.description: Review bounded supplier commitments, readiness records, complete recovery arrangements and optional learning.

useCases.label: Review a first order
useCases.description: Review readiness, complete shipment and recovery arrangements, and optional further verification.

useCases.label: Review a first order with pallet staging
useCases.description: Compare complete shipment and EDI-recovery arrangements with additional warehouse staging.

definition.title: Gifting operations
definition.description: Review gift-kit records and complete correction packages. Compare cost-first and earliest-handoff policies, with exact-configuration confirmations for arrangements that require them. Includes adaptable standalone apps and guided workflows.

useCases.label: Prepare a gift-kit campaign
useCases.description: Establish the required corrections and compare complete arrangements before committing the gift kits.

definition.title: Venue operations
definition.description: Review complete venue operating commitments against staffing, timing, recorded access and spending requirements. Financial hurdles explain what a commitment would need to recover; customer response remains uncertain.

useCases.label: Review a street-team deployment
useCases.description: Compare complete street-team deployments, inspect conditional expense-recovery thresholds, and record a scoped proposal and authorization.

definition.title: Venue operations
definition.description: Review promotion plans against staffing, timing, recorded access and spending requirements. Conditional guest counts explain expense and discount-loss recovery; customer response remains uncertain.

useCases.label: Review a street-team deployment
useCases.description: Compare promotion plans, review conditional break-even guest counts, and record a manager’s choice and scoped approval.
